meta.description: Summer vacancy (Jul-Aug). Overridden to zero for consistency with bedroom vacancy. Raw KT sensor showed ~45% detection but bedrooms were vacant — likely maintenance/cleaning.
Winter break (Dec 15 - Jan 15). Near-zero sensor activity — students away for holidays. Overridden to zero, consistent with bedroom vacancy determination.
Bathroom occupancy from A-8 PIR motion sensor (Jul 2023 - Apr 2024). Academic semester pattern excluding winter break. Fractional values derived from visit probability and duration scaling.
meta.source: A-8-OCC-FD motion sensor, Syracuse University apartment
meta.sensor_period: Oct 2023 - Apr 2024 (excl. Dec 16 - Jan 15 winter break)

meta.description: Summer pattern (Jul-Aug). Higher activity, earlier mornings, more daytime use. Low-res sensor period - pattern reliable, absolute values less certain.
Fall semester pattern (Sep-Dec 15). Strongest weekday morning peak at 9am. Heavy evening cluster 5-8pm. Most representative academic semester pattern.
Winter break vacancy pattern (Dec 16 - Jan 15). Near-zero occupancy. 20-day continuous vacancy streak (Dec 23 - Jan 11). Use as multiplier = 0 or standalone.

Student bedroom occupancy from PIR sensor A-8 BRW. Base = fall semester (most representative). Most active period. Strong morning peak (0.95-0.96 at 07-08h), slower departure (0.82 at 09h), moderate evening return (0.32-0.41).
meta.source: PIR motion sensor CSV files, Unit A-8 BRW, Jul 2023 - Apr 2024
meta.methodology: Block schedule interpretation of hourly motion-detection fractions. Nighttime = occupied (sleeping). Daytime blocks assigned based on motion decay/recovery pattern per season.

meta.description: Pre-semester, essentially unoccupied (avg motion ~0.12 flat, no diurnal pattern)
Vacant. Weekday motion 0.00 across all hours. Negligible weekend signal from ~2 days.
Active but lower than fall. Faster morning departure (drops at 08h), deeper daytime trough (0.08 at 16h), weaker evening return (0.13-0.25).
Spring semester (Jan 15 - Apr 30). Lower than fall across all hours — consistent with bedroom and bathroom declining spring trend. Sensor-derived, detection rate as direct occupancy fraction.

Service hot water usage pattern — morning and evening peaks. Base = fall semester academic pattern. Derived from measured DHW energy (Water 1 + Water 2 meters, 15,668 kWh/yr building). Use with seasonal #N overrides for annual simulation.
meta.source: Back-calculated from AAA.csv water heater sub-meters, 70/30 bath/kitchen split
